critical_code_review_comments: KprPanel: valid_until field uses DatePickerField which is a button (not text input) — for a11y/tests, adding an aria-label with the expected date format would help. Not a bug.

monthlyInstallment @180/5% differs by 46 rupiah from the expected value in the problem statement (1.976.984 vs 1.977.030). This is due to rounding (Math.round of annuity formula). Not a defect; documentation nit.

kpr_products_router.import_products: duplicate detection within a single file relies on lowercased (bank_name, name) tuple — good. Row numbers in error messages correctly refer to the 1-based sheet rows including header.
